Game Overview

Mad Pursuit is a racing game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Mad Pursuit follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Mad Pursuit?

Mad Pursuit is a free racing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Mad Pursuit free to play?

Yes, Mad Pursuit is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
